=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1994,2311-2322 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The release job `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (`timeout-minutes: 20`) takes on the hooks job's largest unsplit step without a measured check of its runtime headroom.
  WHY: If the combined runtime goes over 20 minutes, the job is cancelled and `CI / lint` turns red. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT, gemini and glm rated it MAJOR. The highest, MAJOR, is mapped to high.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2315-2316 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comment says the moved test file has "about 244 subprocess call sites", but the reviewers counted about 145 `subprocess.` occurrences. The sonnet reviewer also flagged the copy at tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:2779.
  WHY: A wrong figure gives later budget decisions a bad starting point. The glm reviewer dropped this finding as unverifiable, so it is not in the flagged_by list.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2323-2334 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The moved step is the last step of the release job and has no `if: always()`, so an earlier step failing makes it skip.
  WHY: Its coverage drops out of a failed run. The job still fails and `CI / lint` still goes red, and the behaviour is the same as in the hooks job.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:2573-2576,2724,2738,2767 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_TO_HOOKS_TARGET_JOB_ID`, the class `MovedHealToHooksStepsContractTest` and two of its method names still say "hooks", but the target is now `tests-release-and-log-analysis`.
  WHY: The names are misleading to the next maintainer. The assertions pass.
- tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:2724-2780,2820-2826 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `MovedHealToHooksStepsContractTest` duplicates `MovedHooks8730StepsContractTest`, and its guard check (`assertNotIn("if", step)` only) is weaker because it does not check `strategy`.
  WHY: A matrix added to the release job later would be caught only by the newer class, so the two classes can drift.
